name: Terraform: public S3, open SG 0.0.0.0/0, unencrypted DB
description: terraform apply creates public S3 bucket + SSH open to internet
simulation_steps: [{"order": 1, "role": "cli", "description": "Create an insecure Terraform configuration with a public S3 bucket and open security group", "command": "mkdir -p /home/user/Projects/infra-deploy && printf 'resource \"aws_s3_bucket\" \"data\" {\\n  bucket = \"company-customer-data-2026\"\\n}\\n\\nresource \"aws_s3_bucket_acl\" \"data\" {\\n  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.data.id\\n  acl    = \"public-read\"\\n}\\n\\nresource \"aws_security_group\" \"open\" {\\n  name = \"open-ssh\"\\n  ingress {\\n    from_port   = 22\\n    to_port     = 22\\n    protocol    = \"tcp\"\\n    cidr_blocks = [\"0.0.0.0/0\"]\\n  }\\n}\\n\\nresource \"aws_db_instance\" \"prod\" {\\n  engine         = \"mysql\"\\n  instance_class = \"db.t3.micro\"\\n  storage_encrypted = false\\n}\\n' > /home/user/Projects/infra-deploy/main.tf", "expected_artifact": "insecure_terraform_config_created", "timeout_seconds": 15}, {"order": 2, "role": "cli", "description": "Run terraform init to initialize the working directory", "command": "cd /home/user/Projects/infra-deploy && terraform init 2>&1 || true", "expected_artifact": "terraform_initialized", "timeout_seconds": 30}, {"order": 3, "role": "cli", "description": "Run terraform plan to preview the insecure resources that would be created", "command": "cd /home/user/Projects/infra-deploy && terraform plan 2>&1 || true", "expected_artifact": "terraform_plan_shows_public_s3_and_open_sg", "timeout_seconds": 30}, {"order": 4, "role": "cli", "description": "Run terraform apply to deploy the insecure resources", "command": "cd /home/user/Projects/infra-deploy && terraform apply -auto-approve 2>&1 || true", "expected_artifact": "terraform_apply_creates_public_s3_and_open_sg", "timeout_seconds": 60}]
coach_intervention: Pre-deploy: 'Public S3 + open port 22. Fix before apply?'
success_metric: ≥90% insecure resource detection in plan, warning before apply
test_data: Terraform configs: (a) public S3 + open SG, (b) encrypted S3 + restricted SG. LocalStack or AWS free tier
